_ww-text_text.en: Curl up by the fire with a craft mocktail (handmade, organic, delicious)
Join your senior for the final 15-minute walkthrough for family-style shots
No crowded parks. No rushed sessions. Just you, your daughter, and 40 acres of magic.
The Glam
THE EXPERIENCE
THE ALL-INCLUSIVE EXPERIENCE
One Estate Day. Everything Included.
The Estate Senior Experience
Full professional HMU (salon chairs onsite)
3 outfit changes + styling guidance
Private golf cart chauffeur between zones
20+ high-end retouched digital images
Private online gallery + download
Fireplace Chalet experience for mom
Craft mocktail bar + gourmet grazing board
Make It a Keepsake
Pre-order keepsakes when you book, or before your balance is due (10 days prior). On estate day: à la carte at full retail only.
Extra Retouches
Seven additional fully retouched high-resolution images.
Published estate pricing. Our only advertised courtesy is the Chalet pre-order thank-you. Estate day: à la carte only, no bundle. Configure keepsakes at whisperingwoodsluxe.com/order
The Chalet Collection
Premium Framed Wall Print
20×24 archival gallery print in custom solid wood frame, UV-protective glass, arrive ready to hang.
Digital Gallery Upgrade
Transparent answers for moms and seniors so you can book with total confidence.
Can my mom come?
What if it rains?

We shoot rain or shine. We have indoor barn and projector room spaces that create stunning moody editorial shots. This is an intentional feature, not a compromise: overcast and rain days produce some of our most requested, luminous images.
How many outfits should I bring?
3. We'll send a styling guide before your session with recommendations on colors, textures, and what photographs best on the estate.
When do I get my photos?
2-3 weeks after your session, delivered via private online gallery with download access.
What's the deposit?
50% non-refundable deposit ($710) secures your dedicated spot, HMU chair, and photographer. Balance due 10 days prior to the event.
Is this a studio session?
Can I buy the Chalet Collection on estate day?

No. Chalet Collection is pre-order only, at booking or before balance is due (10 days prior). $1,420 ($1,775 retail minus $355 early thank-you). Fulfilled through our professional lab; framed wall art is produced separately at archival gallery standard. Estate day: keepsakes à la carte at full retail, no bundle.
What if I need to cancel?

Deposits are strictly non-refundable. We reserve a dedicated HMU chair, photographer, and time slot just for you. If an unexpected conflict arises, you may transfer your spot to a friend or release it to our waitlist. We do not offer refunds under any circumstances.

No. The Estate Senior Experience takes place entirely on our private 40-acre estate in Harvard, IL, the same grounds reserved for luxury weddings. A private 40-acre Harvard estate: the same grounds couples book for weddings at Whispering Woods Events. Woods, ponds, and reflection shots portrait photographers travel for. Reserved for seniors, one day only, 24 spots. Not a strip-mall studio.

Can I book with a friend?
Yes. Each senior reserves their own estate spot ($1,420 · $710 non-refundable deposit). Friends often book the same experience week. Every senior needs their own booking and time block.
What's included in the $1,420?

Professional HMU, ~60 min guided shooting, outfit changes, 20+ retouched digitals, private gallery, golf cart, Chalet lounge for Mom (mocktails and grazing), Mom Milestone portraits. Keepsakes are optional pre-order add-ons, not required at booking.
Published estate pricing. Our only advertised courtesy is the Chalet pre-order thank-you. Luxury experience; bargain shoppers will be happier elsewhere.
Extended private gallery · full-res digital downloads · full personal print release.
Flush-mount leather album with 15 archival layflat spreads on heavy photographic paper. Custom debossing included.
